options.name: --color
options.description: Colors the JSON output: auto (when the output is a terminal and NO_COLOR is not set, the default), always, or never.

options.name: --configuration
options.description: The configuration of the build output. By default, the default configuration of each project, usually Debug.

options.name: --file
options.description: The file that holds the queries, one per line. By  default, or with -, the standard input.

options.name: --format
options.description: The format of the output: json (the default,  colored on a terminal), text for a reader, or jsonl, one object per line.

options.name: --framework
options.description: Restricts the query to one target framework, such  as net10.0.

options.name: --project
options.description: The project: a project file, or a directory that  holds one. By default, the only project or solution of the current directory.

options.name: --solution
options.description: The solution: a .sln or .slnx file, or a directory that holds one.

commands.description: Runs several queries, one per line of the standard  input or of --file, over one load of the files. Each line is a command without  'introspect', such as 'show declaration  src/Customer.cs:18'.

commands.name: list

options.name: --all
options.description: Writes every object, without the default limit.

options.name: --color
options.description: Colors the JSON output: auto (when the output is a terminal and NO_COLOR is not set, the default), always, or never.

options.name: --configuration
options.description: The configuration of the build output. By default, the default configuration of each project, usually Debug.

options.name: --count
options.description: Writes only the number of objects that satisfy the conditions.

options.name: --format
options.description: The format of the output: json (the default,  colored on a terminal), text for a reader, or jsonl, one object per line.

options.name: --framework
options.description: Restricts the query to one target framework, such  as net10.0.

options.name: --limit
options.description: Writes at most this number of objects. By default  100, except with --format jsonl. The output says when the result is truncated.

options.name: --order-by
options.description: The order in the OData $orderby syntax:  expressions separated by commas, each followed by asc or desc, such as  "targetDeclaration/id desc".

options.name: --project
options.description: The project: a project file, or a directory that  holds one. By default, the only project or solution of the current directory.

options.name: --select
options.description: The fields to write, separated by commas, such as  id,aspectClass/shortName,transformations/$count.

options.name: --skip
options.description: Skips the first objects of the result.

options.name: --solution
options.description: The solution: a .sln or .slnx file, or a directory that holds one.

options.name: --where
options.description: A condition in the OData $filter syntax, such as  "aspectClass/shortName eq 'Log'". Several are combined with  'and'. The functions are contains, startswith, endswith,  matchesPattern, indexof, length, substring, concat, tolower, toupper and trim.  Quote it with single quotes in a shell that expands $ inside double quotes, or  escape the $ of $count. See 'introspect schema' for the fields.

arguments.name: COLLECTION
arguments.description: The collection: aspect-classes, aspect-instances,  predecessors, transformations, annotations, declaration-mappings, declarations  or diagnostics.

commands.description: Lists the objects of a collection that satisfy  conditions.

commands.description: Shows the lines of code that PostSharp saved, per  project and target framework, as the Metrics window of Visual Studio:  linesOfCode, the lines written by hand; linesSaved, the lines of code that the  aspects avoided; avoidedRatio, linesSaved / linesOfCode; savedRatio, linesSaved  / (linesOfCode + linesSaved); enhancedTypes, the types that aspects  changed. The total counts the first target framework of each project.
